securityPage.organizationAccessDescription: Configure how users can access your Sourcecat deployment.
securityPage.ssoDescription: Let users sign in with an external identity provider such as GitHub, Google, or Okta. Providers are managed in your config file.
securityPage.noIdentityProviders: No identity providers are configured. Add them in your config file.
securityPage.scimDescription: Provision and deprovision members automatically from your identity provider (Okta, Entra). Configure your IdP with the base URL below and a SCIM token.
securityPage.loginMessageDescription: Show access instructions or a registration link on your sign-in and sign-up pages.
securityPage.scimManagedTooltip: Members are provisioned through your identity provider, so this setting has no effect while SCIM is enabled.

scimUpsell.description: Upgrade to provision and deprovision members automatically from your identity provider.

scimEnabled.name: Enable SCIM provisioning
scimEnabled.description: When enabled, your identity provider can provision and deprovision members via SCIM.
scimEnabled.updateFailed: Failed to update SCIM provisioning setting
scimEnabled.enableDescription: Your identity provider will become the source of truth for membership. While SCIM is enabled, invite links, member approval, and join requests are disabled. Members can only be added or removed through your IdP.
scimEnabled.disableDescription: Members will no longer be synced from your identity provider. Existing members keep their access. Your SCIM tokens aren't revoked, but they'll stop working until you re-enable SCIM.

scimTokens.tokenCount: {count, plural, one {# SCIM token} other {# SCIM tokens}}
scimTokens.tokenInfo: A SCIM token is a Bearer auth token used by your identity provider to call Sourcecat's SCIM API.
scimTokens.createdWarning: This is the only time you'll see this token. Copy it now and paste it into your IdP.
scimTokens.namePlaceholder: Enter a name for your SCIM token
scimTokens.revokeDescription: Are you sure you want to revoke {name}? Your IdP will no longer be able to provision or deprovision users with this token. This action cannot be undone.
